hooks.name: scenario-from-brief
hooks.description: A saved scenario brief becomes a validated scenario file beside it. This is how the kit grows new content. Agent action: uses credits on every save of a brief.

action.prompt: A scenario brief was saved. Read it and the scenario schema in packages/hindsight. Write the scenario file beside it, in the scenarios folder of the same app (one level above briefs/), following every content rule in .kiro/steering/product.md (invented, no real institutions or procedures, none of the out-of-scope topics). The app's scenarios/scenarios.test.ts picks the file up by itself; if you also add a property test, assert that it validates against the schema, every beat is reachable, the run always ends, every decision has at least two options, and for Dead Air every message fits in 64 bytes. Run `pnpm test` for that app (pnpm --filter <app> test) and report the real result. Never edit anything under packages/hindsight. If the brief asks for an out-of-scope topic, stop and say so instead of writing it.
